subject: Hospitality
title: Banquet Operations: Feeding Thousands
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Banquet Operations: Feeding Thousands.

hook.text: Serving 1,000 plated meals simultaneously requires military precision. Every plate must hit the table hot, beautiful.

buildup.text: Banquet kitchens pre-prep days ahead: proteins are portioned, sauces made, vegetables blanched.

discovery.text: The banquet event order (BEO) is the Bible: it specifies every detail—menu, timing, room setup, bar hours, AV needs.

twist.text: Banquet food has a reputation for mediocrity because it must be produced at scale.

climax.text: Hotels with excellent banquet operations earn repeat corporate clients worth millions annually.

punchline.text: 1,000 plates, 15 minutes, every one hot. Banquet kitchens are culinary factories.

quiz.question: What is a BEO (Banquet Event Order)?
options: A document specifying every event detail: menu, timing, setup, AV, and dietary needs
